I am a woman farming a small piece of land here in Mwanza, only a small patch for maize. I have no money to buy fertilizer from the shop — one bag is too much for my little plot and costs too much shillings I do not have. I will put the cow manure I gather behind the house, and I will plant the seeds I saved from last harvest like my mother taught me. My husband helps sometimes but the work on this plot is mostly mine and my children when they come back from fetching water.
